# Redis replica sources alerts compact kit

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

When a Redis replica source alert fires, the source fact SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the specific alert name, source fact SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the alert condition, and source fact SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the remediation step are needed to resolve the alert.
